infrastructure_incidents.cause: SC2251 in Batch 10 scope-test negative assertions under set -e; no package state was evaluated by Repository Policy.

Batch 10 validator incorrectly required a literal KQuickCharts path token and looked for package_validation_dependencies in selector/workflow instead of campaign metadata; scope test and global discovery validator had already passed.

Runner recursively scanned all debian metadata and matched documentation of rejected BUILD_QCH/QT_QML_NO_CACHEGEN overrides (and could also match legitimate fixture cleanup '|| true') before source/rootfs build.
